image.alt: Don’t miss the launch of Toynbee Talks The Mind-Body Connection with Anisha Joshi — Toynbee Hall

sections.text: As seen on ITV’s This Morning, Anisha Joshi is a leading voice in the field of osteopathy and mental health, with a deep understanding of how emotional wellbeing directly impacts physical health. With years of clinical experience, Anisha has helped countless people understand the powerful connection between the mind and body, offering practical solutions to support long-term wellbeing. Now, she’s bringing her expertise to Toynbee Hall for an engaging evening that promises to enlighten, inspire, and offer tangible takeaways for improving both your mental and physical health.

An Interactive Talk: Anisha will explain how emotional stress and mental health challenges manifest in the body, from pain to fatigue, and share practical tips for managing both mental and physical wellbeing.
Live Q&A: After the talk, you’ll have the chance to ask Anisha any questions and get personalized advice.
Networking & Refreshments: Enjoy drinks and mingle with fellow attendees before and after the talk to share experiences and make new connections.

Whether you’re managing stress, curious about the mind-body link, or seeking practical wellbeing tools, this event offers actionable insights and strategies for improving both mental and physical health.
Limited Tickets Available – Don’t Miss Out!

This is an exclusive opportunity to hear from one of the UK’s leading osteopaths and mental health advocates. We’ve got limited spots available for this event, so grab your ticket now before they’re gone! Whether you’re joining to learn more about the mind-body connection or to gain practical advice on improving your health, this is an event you won’t want to miss. With all proceeds going directly into Toynbee Hall charity, helping us make a real difference to the clients we serve.
